newsitem.title: INDIA: Profit-taking traps Delhi shares in tight range.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking traps Delhi shares in tight range.

text.p: Profit-taking by speculators and mutual funds erased early gains, locking Delhi share prices in narrow ranges in afternoon trade on Wednesday, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index was 0.38 point down at 802.55 at 12.45 p.m. (0715 GMT). The index had risen to 806.68 in early trade.
Brokers said, however, that prices remained on a fundamental upward trend.
"Despite a drop in some stock prices, the sentiment seems to be bullish as foreign investors continued to make purchases in the blue-chip shares," said Prem Arya of brokerage Share Kendra.
